title: 3D-Gebäudemodell LoD2 Berlin — CONTEXT / HEIGHTS ONLY
notUsedForNote: ⚠ LoD2 supplies EXISTING built form only. It is CONTEXT, not a rule. Never substitute a LoD2 measured height for the legal maximum height of a plan.
knownIssue: Previous WFS URL returned 404; publication route changed. Reconfirm via FIS-Broker 'S 3D-Gebäudemodell LoD2' / GDI-BE service listing before use.
renderNote: Ties to the known white-mask terrain defect: the terrain bake MUST enable vertex normals + terrain lighting (see MEMORY: City Replication Standard). LoD2 supplies context massing atop that terrain.
probeRequired: Reconfirm the live LoD2 WFS endpoint (404 on prior URL).
Confirm CityGML LoD2 field names (measuredHeight, storeysAboveGround, roofType, buildingFunction).
Confirm CRS EPSG:25833 + vertical DHHN2016 and licence.
